title: Safe Fungicide Use for Smallholder Farmers
title_hi: छोटे किसानों के लिए सुरक्षित फफूंदनाशक उपयोग
content:
Safe and effective fungicide use is critical for smallholder farmers. In India, pesticide misuse causes ~40,000 hospitalizations annually (AIIMS 2024 study).

Core safety rules:
1. ALWAYS read the label. Dosage is crop-specific and stage-specific.
2. Wear protective equipment: gloves, mask, long-sleeved clothing, and closed shoes.
3. Never mix different pesticides unless the label explicitly says it is compatible.
4. Do NOT spray during flowering — it kills pollinators and can cause grain sterility.
5. Maintain a Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) — usually 15-21 days. Do NOT harvest before this.
6. Dispose of empty containers safely — triple-rinse and puncture. Never reuse for food/water.
7. Store pesticides in locked cabinets away from children, food, and water sources.

Application timing: Spray in early morning or late evening when bees are not active and wind speed is low (<8 km/h). Do NOT spray if rain is forecast within 24 hours.

Alternatives: For many fungal diseases, neem oil (5 ml/L), Trichoderma viride (4g/kg seed treatment), and Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/L foliar) are effective, cheaper, and safer than synthetic fungicides.
content_hi:
फफूंदनाशक का सुरक्षित उपयोग छोटे किसानों के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है।

सुरक्षा नियम:
1. हमेशा लेबल पढ़ें।
2. दस्ताने, मास्क, पूरी बांह के कपड़े पहनें।
3. अलग-अलग कीटनाशक कभी न मिलाएं।
4. फूल आने के समय स्प्रे न करें।
5. फसल कटाई से 15-21 दिन पहले स्प्रे बंद कर दें।

विकल्प: नीम तेल, ट्राइकोडर्मा, स्यूडोमोनास।
summary: Safe fungicide use: read labels, wear PPE, never mix chemicals, respect pre-harvest interval. Consider neem oil and biocontrol alternatives.
summary_hi: सुरक्षित फफूंदनाशक उपयोग: लेबल पढ़ें, सुरक्षा उपकरण पहनें, कभी न मिलाएं। नीम तेल और जैविक विकल्प अपनाएं।
actions: Before applying any fungicide, read the product label completely. Check the recommended crop, stage, and dosage.
Wear gloves, a mask, and long-sleeved clothing during application. Wash hands and clothes immediately after spraying.
Spray in early morning (6-8 AM) or late evening (4-6 PM) when wind is calm.
Consider neem oil spray (5 ml per litre of water) as a first-line treatment for mild fungal issues — it is safer and cheaper.
Maintain at minimum 15 days between last fungicide application and harvest.
Triple-rinse empty containers, puncture them, and dispose at a designated collection point. Never reuse for food or water.
warnings: Do NOT apply any fungicide during flowering stage — it kills pollinators and causes grain sterility.
Do NOT mix different pesticides — chemical reactions can create toxic compounds or reduce effectiveness.
Store all pesticides locked away from children, food items, and water sources.
